issue.title: Stale symvision --epic-symbol whitelist entries for closed bead sase-bj.3 fail just lint
issue.description: just lint (the symvision stage in the Justfile around line 273-274) fails with: 'Error: --epic-symbol sase-bj.3(CommitMessagePolicy): bead sase-bj.3 is closed. Remove this stale --epic-symbol entry and clean up the symbol.' and the same for CommitSubject. Per sase/memory/symvision.md, epic-symbol whitelist entries are meant to be self-cleaning once their bead closes/lands -- the CommitMessagePolicy and CommitSubject symbols need to either gain a real non-test consumer now that sase-bj.3 has closed, or be deleted along with their now-stale --epic-symbol Justfile entries. This blocks just lint/just check in every workspace until fixed. Noticed while implementing an unrelated plan (epic_prompt_link_race); did not investigate or fix because the owning epic (sase-bj, 'Reject non-conventional commit subjects in sase commit') still has an actively-running phase (sase-bj.4) as of 2026-07-31 09:xx, so touching the same symbols/Justfile entries concurrently risked conflicting with that in-flight work.
